hazards.evidence: The staircase has a handrail on only the right side; no handrail is visible on the left.
The right-hand handrail stops well before the bottom of the staircase and does not cover the full flight.
Shoes and a stack of folded items are placed on separate stair treads, obstructing the route.
The staircase is dimly lit with heavy shadows across multiple steps.
The carpeted step edges have little visual contrast and are difficult to distinguish in the dim lighting.
